name: Source guide for a data domain
summary: When what a domain's tables really mean lives with one analyst, the data lead gets a written source guide from an interview and the table list: what one row is, the keys, the joins, the definitions and the known traps, each marked by where it came from, and the open points as numbered questions.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of analytics and reporting work, and its own method for a source guide: six standard questions per table, a mark on every statement for where it came from, three kinds of count an analyst can run and paste back, conflicts kept side by side, and every gap a question for a named owner.
